# kion_azure_role (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion AzureRole by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_azure_role" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the AzureRole to fetch.
